title: Research five AI startups, compare their products and pri...
prompt: Research five AI startups, compare their products and pricing, build an Excel spreadsheet with source URLs, and prepare a launch kit.

plan.title: Identify Target Companies
plan.description: Select 5 target AI companies (Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral AI, Cohere, Scale AI) for product, pricing, and positioning intelligence.

plan.title: Navigate Official Domains
plan.description: Visit each company official web domain using Playwright browser engine with anti-bot resilience and real screenshot capture.

plan.title: Extract Core Intelligence
plan.description: Extract product descriptions, pricing tiers, target users, and exact source URLs from DOM elements.

plan.title: Capture Grounded Evidence
plan.description: Store raw text snippets, timestamps, and page screenshots in the immutable evidence ledger.

plan.title: Flag Uncertainties & Ambiguities
plan.description: Route missing pricing or unverified claims to the Human Review Queue for approval or clarification.

plan.title: Generate Proof Excel Workbook
plan.description: Generate structured .xlsx workbook with custom styling, required columns, and explicit missing-data markers.

plan.title: Independent Verification Pass
plan.description: Reopen workbook from disk in isolated verification engine; validate record count, column schemas, and evidence grounding.

plan.title: Synthesize Launch Kit
plan.description: Compile competitive landscape, product positioning, battle cards, and 3 launch-copy variations with evidence citations.

companies.productDescription: Claude 3.5 Sonnet & Claude Enterprise — Frontier AI safety and foundation models featuring state-of-the-art coding, vision analysis, and 200k context windows.
companies.targetUsers: AI researchers, software engineers, knowledge workers, and enterprise developers.
companies.capturedEvidence: Observed DOM: "Claude is a next-generation AI assistant built on constitutional AI principles. Pricing: Claude Pro $20/month with priority access to Claude 3.5 Sonnet."
companies.notes: Official pricing and API documentation verified with source grounding.

companies.productDescription: Conversational conversational AI answer engine providing direct answers with inline citations, multi-model selection (Claude, GPT-4o, Sonar), and web browsing.
companies.pricing: Free basic search; Perplexity Pro at $20/month or $200/year; Enterprise Pro custom pricing.
companies.targetUsers: Researchers, students, financial analysts, and everyday information seekers.
companies.capturedEvidence: Observed DOM: "Where knowledge begins. Perplexity Pro offers unlimited Copilot queries, file upload analysis, and leading AI models for $20/mo."
companies.notes: Inline citations and real-time web search capabilities extracted and verified.

companies.productDescription: Open-weight and commercial frontier LLMs (Mistral Large, Mistral NeMo, Codestral, Pixtral) offering European AI sovereignty and high-efficiency inference.
companies.pricing: Open weights free for Apache 2.0 / research; La Plateforme API from €2/million tokens; Le Chat enterprise custom tiers.
companies.targetUsers: Enterprises requiring data sovereignty, AI developers, open-source researchers.
companies.capturedEvidence: Observed DOM: "Mistral AI: Frontier AI in your hands. Customizable models with open weights and developer platform API pricing starting at competitive token tiers."
companies.notes: Extracted multilingual benchmarks and European datacenter deployment options.

companies.productDescription: Enterprise foundation models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform, including Command R+, Embed, and Rerank for private corporate data.
companies.pricing: Free developer sandbox; Command R+ API at $2.50-$3.00/million tokens; Private cloud / VPC deployment custom enterprise licensing.
companies.targetUsers: Enterprise IT architects, Fortune 500 data teams, security-conscious B2B developers.
companies.capturedEvidence: Observed DOM: "Cohere enterprise AI platform: Secure LLMs built for business applications. Rerank 3 and Command R+ accessible via cloud or on-premise VPC."
companies.notes: Multi-cloud support (Azure, AWS, OCI) verified in captured metadata.

companies.productDescription: Data foundry for AI — Data annotation, RLHF human evaluation, synthetic data generation, and GenAI enterprise application development (Scale GenAI Platform).
companies.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per labeled annotation unit; Custom enterprise contracts for RLHF model training and Donovan platform.
companies.targetUsers: Autonomous vehicle teams, frontier AI labs, defense and government agencies, enterprise data science teams.
companies.capturedEvidence: Observed DOM: "Scale AI accelerates AI development with high-quality training data, RLHF services, and enterprise GenAI application infrastructure."
companies.notes: RLHF pipelines and public sector enterprise contracts cited.
